scope: Cross-category bottle validation of initializer and target-condition contribution; no new training
user_authorization: User approved the complete screening-first sequence and source meshes need not have512 faces; only the output is512.

source.role: Frozen-A cross-category validation; being in official data train split does not make these A fine-tuning examples or an all-methods-unseen test set

screening.topology: original topology.closed_oriented_g0, including degeneracy and duplicate-face checks
screening.radial: original bbox centre and bbox diagonal; support2050 plus fibonacci8194 =10244 directions; exactly one distinct positive intersection for each
screening.exact: original legacy.exact_accel.audit embedded_endpoint_pass on source mesh
screening.field: original prepare_data r0 on support2050, log(r0/sqrt(mean(r0*r0))) float32; no simplification/subdivision needed for this field
screening.identity: UID and source hash compared with previous A real training/teacher/development parents; exact duplicate inputs deduplicated by predetermined hash order with every excluded row and representative retained

selection.rule: After all225 screening: eligible unique inputs sorted by SHA256('a-condition16-parent-v1:' + uid), select first16
selection.insufficient: Stop at qualification report; no relaxed rules, alternate class or official test supplementation
selection.donor_rule: Sort chosen16 by SHA256('a-condition16-donor-v1:' + uid); cyclic next UID; one-to-one no self donors; fixed for all3 repeats

experiment.repeat_meaning: timing only, not training seeds or independent parent samples
experiment.primary: 4-second latest completed audited candidate pass coverage
experiment.quality: exact-valid actual512, both original Fixed angle floors tolerance1e-6deg, two independent same-field RMS gains>=0.02
experiment.reference: same2050node/4096face radial field, not original bottle asset
experiment.target_seed_rule: optimizer1493501 + sorted_target_index*100; MC1593501/1693501 + sorted_target_index*100; unchanged original runner source_identity rule will be verified before RUN_PROTOCOL
experiment.mismatch: only proxy condition comes from donor; final accepted directions query target radius; target base,faces,field,reference and floors unchanged
experiment.case_order: predeclared original rotated parents and within-parent Latin arm ordering

timing.scope: warm CPU process from frozen prepared field file read; include percase data/support/model load, condition/proxy preparation, initialization, recovery/optimizer, all prior audits and final query
timing.host_gate: original no cl/clang-cl/link/lld-link processes; physical and commit free>=12GiB; host CPU<25%; wait before a case, record after
timing.exceeded_after_case: retain and flag; never drop or choose fastest repeated attempts

interpretation.correct_beats_fixed_and_mismatch: supports transfer and condition matching on this selected eligible bottle set
interpretation.both_learned_similar_and_beat_fixed: compatible with useful common learned initialization; not proof of condition irrelevance
interpretation.negative: no demonstrated transfer here; does not negate old speaker development result
